The [published September question set](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22907695) provides a concrete scope comparison. In the construction category, the small-residential-builder question and the mid-sized-general-contractor question name different buyers, even though both are best-option questions in the same category. Their retained ChatGPT answers were captured on 22 September 2026. A proposal covering one buyer scope should not be described as covering the other merely because it sells the same number of questions. This is a reading of the published task definitions, not a comparison of two suppliers' results or evidence of human buying demand.
